SELECT MAX(CAST(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (K-12)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Alameda' AND `Enrollment (K-12)` > 0	----- bird -----	california_schools
1:
SELECT 
    CAST(`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation Schools'
AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
